leftEvidence.title: A lamb, meal, blood, and marked houses are commanded

points.label: Hearers
points.left: Moses and Aaron receive words for the congregation.
points.right: Moses addresses Israel’s elders, who carry the directions to families.

points.label: Blood
points.left: Blood is a sign on the houses where the meal is eaten.
points.right: Blood is moved from basin to lintel and doorposts with hyssop.

points.label: Future memory
points.left: The first text identifies the night as the LORD’s Passover.
points.right: The second supplies the answer children are to receive in the land.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Moses directs elders, families, hyssop, and doorways

payload.tension: One passage gives the household command before the night; the other shows the command moving through elders into action and future explanation.
payload.title: Instruction and enactment at the door
